native_double_world.scope: Ordinary north-facing closed double chest front silhouette and texture at identical native world camera
native_double_world.visual_inspection: Front central border introduced by opposite clipping direction is gone. The bottom still shows a central texture border; bottom and top fidelity remain unaccepted.

missing_projection_halves.scope: Side camera; ordinary/copper main/sub halves; dynamic hiding and initial regeneration, eight comparisons against the complete native projection oracle
missing_projection_halves.limits: This compares the context path with complete rendering after static adaptation; it validates hidden-neighbor preservation, not top/bottom texture correctness against the real chest actor.

unaccepted_appearance.top: The installed MCStudio importer reverses the up face UV endpoints. This generator still uses the original box_uv up convention; independent top capture is required before accepting a change.
unaccepted_appearance.bottom: Actual low-side world pixels show an extra center border. The down face clipped X sampling direction requires a focused source-coordinate audit and native visual rerun.
unaccepted_appearance.ender: Corrected observed renderer baseline has not yet been captured.
unaccepted_appearance.other_copper_materials_and_directions: Generated assets and offline tests cover all stages/directions, but this round has no independently accepted native world camera comparisons for each material/direction.

world_alignment.native_reference: Native player-placed chest actors in the owned world; placement supports removed before capture
world_alignment.scope: Closed ordinary chest, north facing, single and double; identical world origin and measured camera

single.source_run_limit: Second case interrupted by a QA assertion when rewriting an already-air support; fixed before the separate double-case run

missing_projection_halves.scope: Side view; complete native projection oracle versus dynamic hiding and initial regeneration
missing_projection_halves.observed_failure: Remaining native model edges thicken and red channel error reaches 21.8-24.7; the high virtual-coordinate context path remains unaccepted

independent_native_ui.scope: Ordinary/trapped, single/double, four directions; independent native actor and static palettes in one UI control
independent_native_ui.limits: Bounds are normalized, so this is appearance evidence only. Four Ender baselines used empty renderer data and are invalid; the corrected observed Ender renderer has not yet been captured. Copper materials are not covered by this report.
